serve pages open at activation from the previous cache: Safari's page is not reliably a client then; failed with differing bytes (r5)

chrome_soak.finding: the pane's stamped memory saturates into a solid cobalt field past ~48,000 refusals; an unattended tab also renders at 60 fps indefinitely. chrome_weak_device.software_gl_after: governor steps down within seconds, then gives the device the paper cover; 0 frames after
